jobs.title: Senior Mechatronic System Architect | Medical Robotics (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Senior Mechatronic System Architect | Medical Robotics (m/f/d) Location: Maastricht, Aachen, and Eindhoven region, working mainly on-site with our development partner in Maastricht. Regular travel to Hamburg and to clinical sites, about 2 to 4 days per month. Reports to: CTO About the venture: ROB E ROB E is a Hamburg-based medtech startup and part of the NLC Health Ventures portfolio. We are developing a robotic system that holds and steers a standard transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe during structural heart interventions. Interventionalists get stable, reproducible echo views, and echocardiographers no longer have to stand next to the patient in the X-ray field. Our first-generation prototype has been used in a first-in-human study with published results. We are now developing the next generation from scratch as a fully compliant medical device for CE marking and FDA clearance. The team includes a CTO, a System Software Architect and a Head of Quality & Regulatory. The role You are the mechatronic design authority of ROB E. You own the system architecture, the hardware requirements and the technical decisions for the mechanics, drives, sensing and electronics of our robot. You work on site with our engineering development partner in the Maastricht area and steer their team on our behalf. This is a hands-on senior role: you design yourself, review the work of others and make sure the hardware is safe, verifiable and ready for design transfer. Responsibilities Define and own the mechatronic system architecture: robotic device, drives, force and torque sensing, real-time controllers, safety supervisor, power supply and the interface to commercial TEE probes. Translate user and system requirements into subsystem and interface specifications and keep them traceable through verification. Act as technical counterpart to our engineering development partner, from ideation, technology and part selection through design reviews and approval of design outputs. C

jobs.title: Chief Medical Officer, UK/I & EMEA
jobs.description: Chief Medical Officer, UK/I & EMEA The Role Lyrebird is reshaping how clinical documentation happens across the NHS and in Ireland, and we’re looking for a Chief Medical Officer to be the senior clinical voice of the business. Reporting to the CEO, you’ll make sure everything we build, deploy and sell is clinically safe, evidence-based and genuinely useful to clinicians and patients. You’ll own our clinical safety and governance framework, including DCB0129 and oversight of the Clinical Safety Officer function. You’ll shape the product roadmap alongside Product and Engineering, build the evidence base that NHS and HSE buyers need, and act as a trusted peer to CCIOs, CMIOs, medical directors and ICB leaders. This role suits a practising or recently practising doctor who has led at a senior level in the NHS and knows digital health from the inside. You’re comfortable moving between a board presentation, a hazard log and a conversation with engineers in the same afternoon. You’ll enjoy the pace of a high-growth company, but you’ll never trade safety for speed. You believe clinical AI should be held to the same standards as the rest of medicine, and you want to be the person who proves it can be. About Us Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians’ most time-consuming tasks. Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. In the UK, that includes NHS trusts across Cheshire and Merseyside, Alder Hey Children’s, and the South West London Acute Provider Collaborative, one of the largest ambient AI deployments in the country. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load, and delivering meaningful impact at scale. jobs.description: Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development. We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there. If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you! Serving as a primary liaison between investigative sites, Alimentiv and sponsors, the Sr. CRA plays a key role in the successful execution of clinical studies from site selection and start-up through monitoring and close-out. This role also provides guidance and mentorship to CRA I and CRA II colleagues and may participate in CRA assessment visits, co-monitoring activities, audits and inspections. Key Responsibilities Independently conduct and document onsite and remote site management activities, including site qualification, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits, in accordance with applicable SOPs and study requirements. jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. The Opportunity: Senior Engineering Manager As an Engineering Manager at myTomorrows, you will lead Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers building the platforms that help patients find their treatment options. Our Expanded Access Program (EAP) platform and Clinical Trials (CT) platform connect patients and healthcare professionals with treatments in development and give our BioPharma Partners the tools to run their programs and trials. You’ll shape how these platforms grow, building a high-performing team that ships well-designed, scalable, secure and compliant software, and delivers it on time. You won’t do it alone.
